g.text: The classifier's margin over Model 0 runs from +99 points on traffic spikes to 0 on dependency failure

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Blue: faults caught (higher is better). Red: false alarms on healthy windows, the price of the gain (higher is worse).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Model 0, the simple threshold rule, flags a window when any service's p95 latency is above 2x normal or its 5xx share is above 5%, against the mean of the 3 earlier windows.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Against the weaker version (the previous window only), the margin on all faults is +63 [58, 68] points. Intervals: 1,000 bootstrap resamples of whole runs.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Test set, headline runs (320 runs, 2,092 windows). Source: M9-3.
